title: 第167章 飞花拈叶，摧敌首脑。
slug: 满级小李飞刀我在水浒当判官
content_zh:
下一刻，李逸身形一闪，被劈成两半的传讯雀便被他一把捞在了手中。

此刻的李逸得了白云城主叶孤城那凌厉的剑意传承，一身轻功也早已出神入化。

说一声翩若惊鸿，婉若游龙，是一点都不过分。

先前在祝家庄之时他面对花荣的飞箭尚需动用飞刀。

杨嘉祯看到自家弟弟炸毛的样子，只是云淡风轻的笑笑并不以为意。在他的想法里，他现在会反抗是正常的，之后不会反抗也是确实的。因为他还年轻，还不会为了自己要守护的东西不择手段，还不会权衡利弊。

我满意的看着每一个队员，我相信此刻在他们心中团队已经变成了一个很重要的名词。

药鼎狂躁，里面的孕气像是被逼急了一般，一个劲儿的往大破境丹里钻，原本应该晶莹洁白的大破境丹，这一下竟然慢慢显示出其他的颜色，这是什么情况？难道是挑战极品丹药失败了？

木质地板，男人就那样靠坐在墙角，脚边的酒瓶洒落一地，空气中弥漫着香烟和酒精的味道，看着让人心疼。

……，像是心口被什么堵住了，聂婉箩感觉有千万种情绪在涌动，却说不出来其中具体的一种。

菜已经上齐了，没有什么特别名贵的菜，也没有什么太普通的菜，都是附近酒店师傅的拿手特色菜，颜色非常好看，让人一看就有食欲的样子。

主动流产？乔能心猛地一震，仿佛有一阵无法承受的剧痛袭来，他捂着心口弓下身，低头，泪水再度不受控地往下落，一滴滴地打光洁的地板上。

冷月玲没有多说什么，真是简单的四个字“我知道了”声音还是很冷，就如现在外边的天气。

见到铁彦男买，她就那种娇羞的表情。可他买，就一千一万个不情愿。

不等老者给兵奇锐解释，突现的一幕震撼了所有人。天空一下子黑了起来，随之狂风大作。“难道真是大风吹？”蓝月妍失神，她搞不懂这是怎么一回事了。不是说大风吹是神行家的不传之秘么？

可是其明白自己的情况，以佢的资质悟性，单凭着自己的努力，能够取得如此高的修真成就，便几乎到了尽头，今后想要再进一步可谓是千难万难。

再也控制不住自身的愤怒情绪，金焰一闪，龙腾天地便朝丁香儿冲了过去。

做完登记后嫌平头哥他们太招眼了，林曼曼就把他们收回了灵宠空间。但是因为三只灵宠对别人造成了很大的刺激，因此还在登记处的一众学生都知道了那三只灵宠的主人叫林曼曼。

两三里外，尘土纷扬，但见那地上，不知滚动着多少人，更且有一匹黄马也在地上翻滚。再细看时，滚着的那些人，全是他的手下护从，高曦也在其中。

却是难得秦敬嗣，谨守李善道的命令，没人出来上岗，他就代替他们，独自一人在谷口站岗。

一路上，并未遇到费青奴部。到了城外，也不见费青奴部的踪影。

和晏三合想象中的一样，这人有副好皮相，哪怕白发蓄须，也不掩周身的贵气。

上来就送他电吉他，还能让他不舒服了好久的身体变得轻松多了。

他这样做只是为了保全无双楼的威严，如今人人都认为叶云死亡，权利之争蠢蠢欲动，这样一来，倒也算是给玉无双留足了颜面，警告他们想要生出异心，就得先过林凡这一关。
content_en:
The next moment, Li Yi's body flashed, and the messenger bird that was split in two was caught in his hands.

At this moment, Li Yi had inherited the fierce swordsmanship from Ye Gucheng, the lord of Baiyun City, and his light kung fu had already reached perfection.

It is not an exaggeration to say that he is as graceful as a startled dragon and graceful as a swimming dragon.

Previously at Zhujiazhuang, he had to use a flying knife when facing Hua Rong's flying arrows.

Yang Jiazhen saw his brother's hairy appearance, but he smiled lightly and didn't take it seriously.In his mind, it is normal for him to resist now, and it is also true that he will not resist in the future.Because he is still young and will not use any means to protect the things he wants to protect, nor does he know how to weigh the pros and cons.

I looked at every team member with satisfaction. I believe that team has become a very important term in their hearts at this moment.

The medicine cauldron was manic, and the pregnancy energy inside seemed to be driven into panic. It kept drilling into the Great Breakthrough Pill. The Great Breakthrough Pill, which should have been crystal white, now slowly showed other colors. What is going on?Could it be that the challenge for the best elixir failed?

On the wooden floor, the man just sat in the corner, with the wine bottles at his feet scattered on the floor. The air was filled with the smell of cigarettes and alcohol, which made people feel distressed.

..., as if something was blocked in her heart, Nie Wanluo felt that there were thousands of emotions surging, but she couldn't name any specific one.

The dishes have been served, there are no particularly expensive dishes, and there are no dishes that are too ordinary. They are all the specialties of the chefs from the nearby hotels. The colors are very beautiful, and they make people appetizing at the first sight.

Active abortion?Qiao Neng's heart suddenly shook, as if an unbearable pain hit him. He covered his heart and bowed his head, tears falling uncontrollably again, hitting the smooth floor drop by drop.

Leng Yueling didn't say much, just four simple words: "I understand." Her voice was still cold, just like the weather outside now.

When she saw Tie Yannan buying it, she had that shy expression.But he was reluctant to buy it.

Before the old man could explain to Bing Qirui, a sudden scene shocked everyone.The sky suddenly became dark, and then the wind blew violently."Is it really a strong wind?" Lan Yueyan was confused. She couldn't understand what was going on.Isn't it said that strong winds are a secret among spiritual experts?

However, he understands his own situation. With his qualifications and understanding, he can achieve such a high level of cultivation with his own efforts, but it is almost at the end. It will be extremely difficult to go further in the future.

Unable to control his anger any longer, with a flash of golden flame, Long Teng Tian Di rushed towards Ding Xiang'er.

After completing the registration, he felt that Brother Flathead and the others were too eye-catching, so Lin Manman took them back to the spiritual pet space.But because the three spiritual pets caused great irritation to others, all the students at the registration office knew that the owner of the three spiritual pets was named Lin Manman.

Two or three miles away, dust was flying, but I saw how many people were rolling on the ground, and there was even a yellow horse rolling on the ground.When he took a closer look, the people rolling around were all his followers, and Gao Xi was among them.

But it was rare for Qin Jingsi to obey Li Shandao's order. No one came out to take charge, so he took their place and stood guard at the entrance of the valley alone.

Along the way, they did not encounter Fei Qingnu’s tribe.When they arrived outside the city, there was no sign of Fei Qingnu's tribe.

Just as Yan Sanhe had imagined, this man had a good appearance. Even if he had gray hair and a beard, he could not hide his noble aura.

Giving him an electric guitar as soon as he came up made his body, which had been uncomfortable for a long time, feel much more relaxed.

He did this just to preserve the majesty of Wushuang Tower. Now everyone thinks that Ye Yun is dead and the struggle for power is about to begin. In this way, it can be regarded as saving face for Yu Wushuang and warning them that if they want to have any alienation, they must first pass Lin Fan.
title_en: Chapter 167 Flying flowers and picking up leaves destroy the enemy's leader.
